lines.text: The brothers are asked to acknowledge those who work diligently among them and to hold them in highest regard.
The brothers are told to admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and never repay evil for evil.
They are told to rejoice at all times, pray without ceasing, and give thanks in every circumstance.
They are told not to extinguish the Spirit, to test all things, and to abstain from every form of prophecy.
May the God of peace sanctify them completely, and the leaders among them are faithful and will do it.
